top_gaps.title: Monolith vs Microservices
top_gaps.gap: Single-file monolith with all business domains tightly coupled, shared database with no module boundaries
top_gaps.impact: Blocks independent scaling, deployment, and team autonomy

top_gaps.title: CI/CD Automation
top_gaps.gap: No CI/CD pipeline — deployment is manual
top_gaps.impact: Manual deployments are error-prone and prevent continuous delivery

top_gaps.title: Secrets Management
top_gaps.gap: Plaintext credential fallback in source code
top_gaps.impact: Security vulnerability; credentials exposed in source control

top_gaps.title: Deployment Strategy
top_gaps.gap: Direct-to-production deployment with no staged rollout
top_gaps.impact: No ability to catch regressions before all users are impacted

top_gaps.title: Integration Testing
top_gaps.impact: No safety net for code changes; regressions reach production undetected

findings.title: No workflow orchestration for multi-step fulfillment process
findings.description: Multi-step order fulfillment workflow (confirmed → validated → warehouse_assigned → picking → packed → quality_checked → shipped → delivered) is entirely hardcoded in PHP application logic with no orchestration service.
findings.gap: Multi-step business workflow with no dedicated orchestration service, no retry logic, no error handling strategy across steps.
findings.recommendation: Implement AWS Step Functions to orchestrate the fulfillment workflow with retry/catch blocks for each step.

findings.title: No async messaging for cross-domain state changes
findings.description: No messaging or streaming infrastructure exists. All state changes occur synchronously within single HTTP requests, with cross-domain modifications in single database transactions.
findings.gap: No messaging where state changes cross domain boundaries — tight synchronous coupling between concerns that should be decoupled.
findings.recommendation: Introduce Amazon EventBridge or SQS for cross-domain state change propagation.

findings.title: Network security lacks VPC endpoints
findings.description: Services in private subnets with least-privilege security groups and WAF, but no VPC endpoints for AWS service access.
findings.gap: No VPC endpoints for ECR and CloudWatch Logs. App Runner egress traverses internet for AWS service calls.
findings.recommendation: Add VPC endpoints for ECR and CloudWatch Logs to keep traffic within the AWS network.

findings.title: API entry point lacks request validation and throttling
findings.description: App Runner + WAF provides managed HTTPS endpoint with IP-based access control but no API Gateway with request validation or throttling.
findings.gap: No API Gateway with request validation, throttling configuration, or schema-based input validation.
findings.recommendation: Introduce API Gateway with request validation and throttling when decomposing into microservices.

findings.title: Auto-scaling limited to compute only with default settings
findings.description: App Runner auto-scaling configured (min=1, max=3) but no custom scaling policies and no scaling on the data layer.
findings.gap: Auto-scaling limited to compute with default settings. No database auto-scaling. MaxSize=3 may be insufficient.
findings.recommendation: Consider Aurora with auto-scaling read replicas. Increase App Runner MaxSize. Add custom metrics-based scaling.

findings.title: Backup recovery lacks documented restore testing
findings.description: RDS automated backups with 7-day retention and PITR, but no documented restore testing or cross-region replication.
findings.gap: No documented restore testing procedure. No cross-region backup replication.
findings.recommendation: Document and test restore procedures. Consider cross-region read replica for DR.

findings.title: IaC missing monitoring and alerting resources
findings.description: CloudFormation covers ~80% of infrastructure (compute, networking, databases, security) but missing monitoring alarms, SNS topics, and Route 53.
findings.gap: Missing from IaC: CloudWatch alarms, SNS notification topics, Route 53 DNS, explicit AWS Backup plans.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms, SNS topics, and Route 53 health checks to CloudFormation template.

findings.title: No CI/CD automation — all deployments manual
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. Deployment is manual docker-compose or CloudFormation CLI commands.
findings.gap: All deployments are manual — no automated build, test, or deploy stages.
findings.recommendation: Implement AWS CodePipeline with CodeBuild for automated build/test/deploy.

findings.title: PHP without framework limits cloud-native tooling
findings.description: PHP 8.2 vanilla (no framework, no composer.json, no AWS SDK). Limited cloud-native tooling depth.
findings.gap: No PHP framework, no dependency management, no AWS SDK usage.
findings.recommendation: Adopt a framework (Laravel/Symfony) with AWS SDK, or migrate extracted services to languages with stronger cloud-native ecosystems.

findings.title: Tightly-coupled single-file monolith
findings.description: Single-file PHP monolith (~1800 lines) with all business domains, shared database, no module boundaries, pervasive cross-domain data access.
findings.gap: Tightly-coupled monolith with no clear module boundaries, pervasive shared state. Cannot scale or deploy domains independently.
findings.recommendation: Decompose via Strangler Fig pattern. See Decomposition Strategy section.

findings.title: All communication synchronous with no async patterns
findings.description: All communication is synchronous HTTP within the monolith. No message queues, no event publishing, no async processing.
findings.gap: All communication synchronous with no async patterns. State changes that should be decoupled are in synchronous transactions.
findings.recommendation: Introduce EventBridge for domain events and SQS for work queues as prerequisite for decomposition.

findings.title: Multi-step processes lack async job handling
findings.description: Return processing requires 24-48 hour manual review with no background workers. Fulfillment workflow has no async job infrastructure.
findings.gap: Multi-step business processes with no structured async handling. No job queue or background processing.
findings.recommendation: Implement SQS-backed workers for return processing. Use Step Functions for fulfillment workflow.

findings.title: No API versioning strategy
findings.description: All endpoints unversioned (/api/products, /api/orders). No version prefix, headers, or query parameters.
findings.gap: No versioning — breaking changes deployed directly to all consumers.
findings.recommendation: Adopt URL path versioning (/v1/api/products). Use API Gateway stage-based versioning when decomposing.

findings.title: Environment variables only for endpoint configuration
findings.description: Database endpoint via environment variables. No dynamic service discovery for future multi-service architecture.
findings.gap: Environment variables only. No dynamic service discovery for decomposed architecture.
findings.recommendation: Implement AWS Cloud Map for service discovery when decomposing into microservices.

findings.title: No object storage for unstructured data
findings.description: No S3 or managed object storage. Product images referenced by URL with no actual storage backend.
findings.gap: No managed object storage for images, documents, or files.
findings.recommendation: Create S3 buckets for product images, shipping labels, and order documents. Use CloudFront for delivery.

findings.title: No data access abstraction layer
findings.description: Direct SQL queries scattered throughout index.php with no repository pattern, DAO layer, or ORM.
findings.gap: No data access abstraction. Direct SQL queries scattered throughout the codebase.
findings.recommendation: Introduce repository/DAO pattern per domain entity as prerequisite for decomposition.

findings.title: Database version pinned but no upgrade procedure documented
findings.description: RDS MySQL 8.4.8 explicitly pinned (current LTS). Dev environment uses MySQL 8.0 (version mismatch).
findings.gap: No documented version-update procedure. Development/production version mismatch.
findings.recommendation: Document upgrade procedure. Align dev environment to MySQL 8.4.

findings.title: RDS uses AWS-managed encryption key instead of customer-managed
findings.description: RDS StorageEncrypted: true with default AWS key. ECR and Flow Logs use customer-managed KMS keys with rotation.
findings.gap: RDS uses AWS-managed default key rather than customer-managed KMS key.
findings.recommendation: Create customer-managed KMS key for RDS with rotation policy.

findings.title: Session-based auth without token-based (OAuth2/JWT) support
findings.description: Authentication via PHP sessions with bcrypt. Not token-based. Cannot support stateless API consumption.
findings.gap: No token-based authentication. Session-based auth unsuitable for microservices or machine-to-machine communication.
findings.recommendation: Implement Cognito User Pools with JWT tokens for API authentication.

findings.title: Standalone authentication with no centralized IdP
findings.description: Application manages its own auth entirely with local users table. No Cognito, Okta, OIDC, or SAML.
findings.gap: No centralized IdP integration. No SSO, no MFA, no federation capability.
findings.recommendation: Integrate with Amazon Cognito. Migrate users to Cognito User Pool. Enable MFA.

findings.title: Plaintext credential in source code
findings.description: Hardcoded fallback password in source: getenv('DB_PASS') ?: 'ecommerce_pass'. Production credentials as plain environment variables.
findings.gap: Plaintext credential in source code. No Secrets Manager. No rotation.
findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded credential. Migrate all secrets to AWS Secrets Manager with automated rotation.

findings.title: Default base image with no hardening
findings.description: Dockerfile uses php:8.2-apache default image. ECR ScanOnPush enabled but not integrated into any pipeline.
findings.gap: Default base image with no hardening. Vulnerability scanning not actionable without CI/CD.
findings.recommendation: Use hardened base image. Integrate ECR scan results into CI/CD as blocking gate.

findings.title: No application security pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline, therefore no SAST, DAST, or dependency scanning integrated. No security gates.
findings.gap: No security scanning tools in any pipeline. Vulnerabilities reach production undetected.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD with SAST (Semgrep), dependency scanning (composer audit), and ECR scan gate.

findings.title: No distributed tracing
findings.description: No X-Ray, OpenTelemetry, or trace ID propagation. Cannot correlate requests across service boundaries.
findings.gap: No distributed tracing instrumented. Critical for decomposition.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with AWS X-Ray or OpenTelemetry before decomposition begins.

findings.title: No formal SLO definitions
findings.description: Basic health checks and WAF metrics exist but no formal SLOs with error budgets.
findings.gap: No formal SLO definitions. No error budget tracking.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs for critical user journeys with CloudWatch monitoring.

findings.title: No business metrics published
findings.description: No custom business metrics. Only default infrastructure metrics from App Runner and RDS.
findings.gap: No business outcome metrics (orders, revenue, fulfillment time).
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch custom metrics for key business outcomes.

findings.title: No alerting configured
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms. No anomaly detection. System failures go unnoticed until user reports.
findings.gap: No alerting of any kind. No notification mechanism for failures.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for error rate, latency, and capacity metrics with SNS notifications.

findings.title: Direct-to-production deployment with no staged rollout
findings.description: Manual CloudFormation update replaces App Runner service directly. No blue/green, canary, or rolling deployment.
findings.gap: No deployment safety mechanism. Bad deployments affect all users immediately.
findings.recommendation: Implement App Runner deployment with automatic rollback or migrate to ECS with CodeDeploy blue/green.

findings.title: No automated tests
findings.description: Zero test coverage — no unit, integration, or E2E tests exist.
findings.gap: No automated testing. Full regression risk on every change.
findings.recommendation: Add PHPUnit for unit/integration tests. Add tests as CI/CD gate before decomposition.

findings.title: No incident response automation
findings.description: No runbooks, no SSM Automation, no self-healing patterns. Incident response entirely ad hoc.
findings.gap: No incident response procedures or automation.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks for common incidents as SSM Automation documents.

findings.title: No observability ownership structure
findings.description: No CODEOWNERS, no dashboards, no alarms with named owners, no SLOs with team attribution.
findings.gap: No observability infrastructure to own. No ownership structure defined.
findings.recommendation: Define CODEOWNERS and per-domain dashboards with named owners when implementing observability.

findings.title: Inconsistent resource tagging
findings.description: Most resources have Name tags. Some have Environment. No cost allocation or ownership tags.
findings.gap: Inconsistent tagging. No cost allocation, ownership, or tag enforcement.
findings.recommendation: Define tagging standard with required tags (Name, Environment, CostCenter, Team). Add Config rules for enforcement.
